book.name: LUK
book.title: Diꞌs wen chanꞌ Jesucrist jwanꞌ mkeꞌ Luk

content: Jesus mbli ngoga bro toz mbel
Thi wiz ndo Jesus ro nittoꞌ Genesaret, nde men toz tir mdyop lo Jesus axta ngaꞌs xaꞌ Jesus tak ncholaꞌs xaꞌ gon xaꞌ xkiꞌs Dios.
Jesus mbwi' chop bark nalaj nzi gax ro yux, tak re xaꞌ goꞌd mbel mbla xaꞌ lo bark ngetach xaꞌ yeꞌd xaꞌ.
Zyasa ngwap Jesus lo ti bark ya, nde bark ya nak chanꞌ Simon, nde mna'b Jesus lo Simon chep xa'y tud lenꞌ nittoꞌ. Zyasa mdob Jesus lenꞌ bark nde mdobte mbloꞌ Jesus xkiꞌs Dios lo re men.
Senꞌ mne mdaꞌ Jesus xkiꞌs Dios lo men, nchab Jesus lo Simon: —Beꞌ bark ten' na'sxa lenꞌ nit, nde kobi goꞌ yeꞌd goꞌ sa tyen goꞌ mbel.
Zyasa mkab Simon: —Maestr, dib yalꞌ mke náꞌ goꞌd nde nek thib mbel naꞌngagada, per ta lu nyebeꞌy, gobin yeꞌd.
Nde senꞌ mblobi xaꞌ yeꞌd lenꞌ nit bro toz tir mbel ngoga, axta ndo ched yeꞌd.
Zyasa mbli xaꞌ señ mbrez xaꞌ ta xaꞌ ta nzo tedib len' bark, sa ye'd la'sto xa' xaꞌ. Nde mbyed la'sto xa' xaꞌ mtozeꞌ xaꞌ rop bark, lo mze toz rop bark axta ndolathab bark lenꞌ nit.
Senꞌ mbwiꞌ Simon Pedr jwanꞌ ta ngoka, mdoxub xaꞌ lo Jesus nde nchab xaꞌ: —Bike tij lon Xa' Nyebe', tak na nak xaꞌ nzoꞌb xken naꞌ.
Tak nzoyen Simon nde mzyeb toz xa' kon reta xaꞌ nzino xa', lo tant bro mbel ngoga.
Taga' Jakob kon Juan xinꞌ Zebedeo ta god mbel Simon mzyeb toz xaꞌ. Per Jesus nchab lo Simon: —Naꞌzyebta la, tak xata naya le'a yalal men goꞌd, sa lia gan men par Dios.
Senꞌ mzinno xaꞌ rop bark ro yux, mblaꞌ xaꞌ reta jwanꞌ tya, nde mdonke xaꞌ xis Jesus.
Jesus mtodanꞌ thi xaꞌ ndyak ye'sya's

Thi wiz sen' ndo Jesus thi yez ya, mzin thi xaꞌ biꞌ ndyak ye'sya's lo Jesus, senꞌ mbwiꞌ xaꞌ Jesus mdoxub xaꞌ lo Jesus axta mdinꞌ yek xaꞌ izyo nde mnaꞌb xaꞌ lo Jesus nchab xaꞌ: —Xa' Nyebe', Nya'b na loa todan' na, lu toyal liy tez ncholaꞌs la li ley.
Zyasa mtogaꞌ Jesus yaꞌ Jesus nde mbwal Jesus xaꞌ ya nde nchab Jesus lo xaꞌ: —Ncholas na, dyanꞌ la. Nde zyaga mdyanꞌ xaꞌ lo yis ya.
Nde nchab Jesus lo xaꞌ: —Ngen cho lo tej la jwanꞌ reꞌ, benꞌta wa lo nglweyꞌ sa wiꞌ xaꞌ la, nde beꞌ yon jwanꞌ ndablo taꞌa lo ta mbyak la, a xata nyebeꞌ ley chanꞌ Moises, sa loꞌ ke mbyak la.
Mbay che'la masra' mxyob xkiꞌs Jesus, men toz mdyop lo Jesus sa gon xaꞌ kwent ndaꞌ Jesus, nde sa todanꞌ Jesus xaꞌ lo re yis ndyak xaꞌ.
Per Jesus nda re tenꞌ nagan sa todiꞌsno Jesus Dios.
Jesus mtodanꞌ thi xaꞌ nguj thi ble

Thi wiz Jesus ngeloꞌ xkiꞌs Dios lo men, tya mdob re xaꞌ fariseo kon re xaꞌ nak maestr loley, jwanꞌ nde re lo xyon Galilea, Judea nde yez Jerusalen. Nde Jesus ngeno yalne chanꞌ Dios, sa todanꞌ Xaꞌ men.
Zyasa mzin pla xaꞌ ndeno thi xaꞌ nguj thi ble, nzo'b lo yalonꞌ nde ncholaꞌs xaꞌ we xaꞌ xaꞌ axta lenꞌ yo tenꞌ ndo Jesus nde kix xa' xa' lo Jesus,
per naꞌgakta yote xaꞌ, tak men toz tira, zyasa ngwap xaꞌ yek yo nde mkib xa' pla tej, sa tya mbla xaꞌ yalonꞌ nzoꞌb xaꞌ yisa tenꞌ ndo Jesus xtow re men toz tira'.
Senꞌ mbwiꞌ Jesus jwanꞌ toz ndli lazoꞌ re xaꞌ ya Jesus, nchab Jesus lo xaꞌ nguj thi ble yaꞌ: —Mbiꞌ reta xken la mdyonꞌ la.
Zyasa re xaꞌ fariseo nde re maestr nchak ley, mdobte mbli xaꞌ xgab: "¿Cho nak mbiꞌ reꞌ? ¿Kwan ndliy ta narax ni xaꞌ xis Dios? Ngencho li gan tonꞌ xken men, benꞌta Dios tak tonꞌ xken men."
Leꞌ Jesus mnela cho xgab ndli xaꞌ, nchab Jesus lo xaꞌ: —¿Kwan liy ta ndli goꞌ xgab?
¿Cho kwan mas nambi gab na lo xaꞌ: "Leꞌ xken la mdyonꞌla", o gab na lo xaꞌ: "Goche nde pte"?
Sa nye goꞌ leꞌ Xinꞌ Mbiꞌ ngeno yalnyebeꞌ sa tonꞌ Xaꞌ re xken men lo izyo reꞌ. Zyasa nchab Jesus lo xa' nguj thi ble ya: —Leꞌ loa nin, goche, bxen lonꞌ la nde bya liz la.
Nde zyaga ngoche xaꞌ ta nguj thi ble ya, nde nzi wiꞌ re men, mxen xaꞌ lonꞌ xaꞌ ndya xaꞌ liz xaꞌ, nde taja ndaꞌ xaꞌ dyux lo Dios.
Nde reta xaꞌ nzi tya leꞌka nzoyen xaꞌ nde nzyeb xaꞌ, ndaꞌ xaꞌ dyux lo Dios nchab xa: —Naya mbwinꞌ yalnaro chanꞌ Dios.
Jesus mbrez Levi
Senꞌ mne jwanꞌ reꞌ, mbroꞌ Jesus nda Xaꞌ nde mbwiꞌ Xaꞌ thi xaꞌ biꞌ jwan' nyaꞌb tmi low ndole Levi, xaꞌ ya ndob tenꞌ nchax tmi low, nde nchab Jesus lo xaꞌ: —Ptonke xis na.
Zyasa mdoli Levi, mblaꞌ xaꞌ reta jwanꞌ nde mdonke xaꞌ xis Jesus.
Xisa mda' Levi thi yalwa ro liz Levi par Jesus, nde bro xaꞌ jwan' naka sin' nthop tmi low nde temas re men nzi ro mes kon Jesus.
Per re xaꞌ fariseo nde re maestr nchak ley, mdobte ni xin xa' xis re xin'te'd Jesus nde nchab xa: —¿Kwan liy ncha goꞌ nde nchuꞌ go' kon re xaꞌ nthop tmi low nde re xaꞌ nzoꞌb xken naꞌ?
Leꞌ Jesus mkab lo xaꞌ: —Re xaꞌ nadanꞌ nanakinta xaꞌ doktor, benꞌta re xaꞌ nayiz, xaꞌ ya nakinꞌ doktor.
Nandalta na sa bez na re xaꞌ gal' ndo, lenꞌ ndal sa bez na re xaꞌ nzoꞌb xken naꞌ, sa laꞌ xaꞌ jwanꞌ narax nde bere xaꞌ lo Dios.
Jesus ngoꞌxkan xamod nak yalse

Zyasa mnabdiꞌs xaꞌ lo Jesus, nchab xaꞌ: —¿Kwan liy re xin'te'd Juan nke toz xaꞌ yalse nde tibla' ndo di'sno xa' Dios nde tagaꞌ ndli re xin'te'd fariseo, per re xin'te'd la thiblaꞌ ncha xaꞌ nde nchuꞌ xaꞌ?
Jesus mkab lo xaꞌ: —¿Cho nye toyal li goꞌ, sa re xaꞌ nzi lo yalselyaꞌ ke xa' yalse, laja mbyo ndo selyaꞌ ben' ndo xij xa'?
Per tsin wiz senꞌ we xaꞌ or nselyaꞌ, zyasa ke xaꞌ yalse.
Zyasa mdej Jesus thi kwent nagan lo xaꞌ: —Ngen cho thi men nchoꞌ thi ble lar kub sa kibde xa'y lad lar gox. Tez ta li xaꞌ, benꞌta tati xaꞌ lar kub nde tagaꞌ lar gox nanzaltey kebdey kon lar kub.
Nde taga ngen choꞌ ngo bin kub lenꞌ yid gox, tez cho xaꞌ ta li, bin kuba li cheꞌd yid, xyo bin nde akti yid.
Jwanꞌ nasa ndablo ko men bin kub lenꞌ yid kub sa ropa na'yasaꞌda.
Nde re xaꞌ nchuꞌ bin ndala nzo, nanchalaꞌsta xaꞌ gu xaꞌ bin kub, tak mbez xaꞌ: "bin jwanꞌ ndala nzo jwanꞌ na mas naxeꞌ ndyeꞌ."
